name: SurvivalDifficultyProfile - Default (seed v1)
description: A difficulty of a survival scenario: how the enemy count and the enemy stats grow per round, per-player scaling, caps, repair rate and other difficulty values. A scenario can have several; one is the default.

steps.description: Name the difficulty. The default one is used when a match names none.

fields.label: Scenario
fields.description: The siege scenario this belongs to; filled in from the scenario you are editing.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown to players when a difficulty is chosen, e.g. 'Normal' or 'Nightmare'.

fields.label: Default difficulty
fields.description: Marking this one clears the default of the others.

fields.label: Order
fields.description: Leave empty to add it after the existing difficulties.

steps.description: How many enemies a round has (DESIGN §7). Linear: b + a·(round−1). Logarithmic: b + a·ln(round). Exponential: b·m^(round−1). Hybrid: linear up to the switch round, then ×m per round (Call of Duty style). Round 1 has the round-1 count.

fields.label: Preset
fields.description: Linear: b + a·(round−1). Logarithmic: b + a·ln(round). Exponential: b·m^(round−1). Hybrid: linear up to the switch round, then ×m per round (Call of Duty style).

fields.label: Round-1 enemy count (b)
fields.description: Enemies in round 1 for one player (at least 1).

fields.label: Step per round (a)
fields.description: Added per round by the linear, logarithmic and hybrid presets.

fields.label: Multiplier per round (m)
fields.description: Used by the exponential preset, and by hybrid after the switch round.

fields.label: Switch round (s)
fields.description: Hybrid only: the last linear round.

steps.description: One shared growth curve for the enemy stats (round 1 = vanilla, DESIGN S30, S54); each stat follows it with its own weight: multiplier = 1 + weight × (curve − 1). Weight 1 follows the curve fully, 0.3 grows at 30 % of it, 0 keeps the stat vanilla.

fields.label: Preset
fields.description: Linear: b + a·(round−1). Logarithmic: b + a·ln(round). Exponential: b·m^(round−1). Hybrid: linear up to the switch round, then ×m per round (Call of Duty style). The round-1 value is always 1.

fields.label: Step per round (a)
fields.description: Added to the multiplier per round by the linear, logarithmic and hybrid presets.

fields.label: Multiplier per round (m)
fields.description: Used by the exponential preset, and by hybrid after the switch round.

fields.label: Switch round (s)
fields.description: Hybrid only: the last linear round.

fields.label: Health weight
fields.description: How much of the curve the enemies' health follows.

fields.label: Walking speed weight
fields.description: How much of the curve the walking speed follows. Keep it low: pathfinding breaks above an effective speed of 0.5.

fields.label: Melee damage weight
fields.description: How much of the curve the melee damage follows.

fields.label: Ranged damage weight
fields.description: How much of the curve the ranged (projectile) damage follows.

fields.label: Attack speed weight
fields.description: How much of the curve the attack speed follows.

steps.description: Per-player scaling (DESIGN S55: × (1 + p × (players − 1)), players counted at round start, ghosts included) and the caps.

fields.label: Per-player factor (p)
fields.description: Always scales the enemy count; 0 = off.

fields.label: Scale the stats per player too
fields.description: Off by default: then only the count grows with the player count.

fields.label: Max enemies alive
fields.description: The rest of a round's queue spawns as others die. 0 = unlimited.

fields.label: Stat cap
fields.description: The maximum stat multiplier (applied last; at least 1).

fields.label: Count cap
fields.description: The maximum enemies per round. 0 = unlimited.

fields.label: Repair rate
fields.description: Door health repaired per second per repairing player (DESIGN §5: a 1000-health door with rate 50 takes 20 s alone, 10 s with two).

fields.label: Gate damage factor
fields.description: Multiplier on the enemies' gate damage (1 = the mob's normal damage).

fields.label: Capture weight
fields.description: Weight of one enemy in the objective capture calculation (1 = a player).

fields.label: Spawn interval (ms)
fields.description: Minimum time between two spawns of a round.

fields.label: Aggro radius (blocks)
fields.description: Players within this radius can divert enemies. Leave empty for the plugin's default.

fields.label: Leash distance (blocks)
fields.description: An enemy dragged further than this from its route returns. Leave empty for the plugin's default.
